offering_description.value: OUTFRONT Media sells advertising space to national and local advertisers and their agencies. It operates static and digital billboards and displays ads on transit vehicles, in stations, and on street furniture, often through agreements with transit agencies and property owners.

primary_services.value: billboard advertising; transit advertising; street furniture advertising; ad creative and production; campaign planning and measurement

customer_segment.value: B2B: national brands, local businesses, and media buying agencies; B2G: public agencies buying space for public awareness campaigns

end_markets.value: retail; media and entertainment; consumer goods; travel and tourism; public information campaigns

revenue_model.value: advertising: placements on static billboards, digital screens, transit vehicles, and station displays

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: operates owned and leased billboards and uses transit display rights to sell placements to advertisers; service provider: uses advertiser creative and campaign briefs to plan, install, and manage ads for brands and agencies

geography_served.value: US national: billboard and transit markets across the United States

specialization.value: related lines: static and digital billboards, transit displays, and street furniture advertising

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: national and local sales teams serving advertisers and agencies; agents / brokers: media buying and out-of-home specialist agencies purchasing placements for clients; online: programmatic ad platforms for buying digital display inventory

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: billboard siting and display rules under the Highway Beautification Act and state and local sign ordinances
